[USER] User expressed interest in modern innovations in harp design and technology.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Carbon Fiber Harps improve strength, durability, and sound quality, suitable for professionals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lever Harps allow easy key changes without retuning, revolutionizing modern harp playing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Electronic Harps use circuits to produce sound, enabling a wide range of tones and effects.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Extended Range Harps have added strings for increased range without sacrificing playability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Semi-Acoustic Harps combine electric and acoustic components for a warm, resonant sound.  
[USER] User was surprised by the number of innovations in harp design and technology.  
[USER] User asked which innovation has made the biggest impact on modern harp music.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Many harpists argue that lever harps have had the biggest impact due to ease of key changes and accessibility for beginners.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other innovations like electronic harps and carbon fiber harps also significantly contribute to modern harp music.  
[USER] User finds the harp to be a beautiful instrument.  
[USER] User inquired about the types of music best suited for lever harps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lever harps are suited for traditional Celtic, folk, modern pop, and jazz music.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lever harps are versatile for accompanying singing and can easily switch keys.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The range of music depends on the harp's size and number of strings.
